page.help: Tools that make the server livelier: members can suggest ideas and vote on them, popular messages get a place of honour (the starboard), important notes stay at the bottom of a channel, saved replies answer common questions, and new YouTube videos are announced.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.help: Members share ideas with /suggest new in Discord. Each idea is posted in this channel, and members vote with the buttons under it.
suggestions.channelHelp: Where new suggestions are posted for members to vote on.

open.title: Open suggestions ({count})
open.help: Approving or denying ends the voting. The suggestion message is updated and the member who made it gets a private message (DM). You can also do this with /suggest status in Discord.
open.reasonHelp: Shown on the suggestion and sent to the member who made it.
open.needsAdmin: To decide suggestions you need the Administrator permission in this server.

starboard.title: Starboard
starboard.help: When a message gets enough of one reaction, Mewvo copies it to the starboard channel, so the best moments are easy to find.
starboard.channelHelp: Where the popular messages are copied to.
starboard.emojiHelp: The reaction that counts, for example ⭐.
starboard.thresholdHelp: How many of those reactions a message needs before it is copied.

sticky.title: Sticky messages
sticky.help: A sticky message stays at the bottom of a channel. When members write, Mewvo posts it again under their messages, so rules or notes are always easy to see.
sticky.channelHelp: Mewvo needs the Manage Messages permission here to remove its old copy.
sticky.messageHelp: If the channel already has a sticky message, this replaces it.

tag.title: Tags
tag.help: Saved answers members can post with /tag show. A tag can also reply by itself when someone writes a certain word.
tag.triggerHelp: none: only posted with /tag show. word: replies when a message contains the word or phrase below. regex: replies when a message matches a pattern (for advanced users).
tag.cooldownHelp: After replying in a channel, the tag waits this long before it replies there again.
tag.cooldownNewHelp: After replying in a channel, the tag waits this long before it replies there again. Leave empty for the default.
tag.allowChannelsHelp: Pick none to allow every channel.
tag.name: Name
tag.nameHelp: Members post the tag with /tag show and this name. Small letters, numbers, - and _ only, like rules or how-to-join.

feed.title: YouTube feeds
feed.help: Mewvo announces new videos from a YouTube channel. It checks every 15 minutes.
feed.sourceHelp: The link to the YouTube channel, or its channel ID (it starts with UC).
feed.messageHelp: Leave empty for the default message. You can use {author} (the channel name), {title} (the video title) and {url} (the link to the video).

action.reasonTooLong: The reason is limited to {max} characters.
action.noSuggestion: There is no suggestion #{id} in this server.
action.notUpdated: The suggestion message could not be updated (deleted or no access).
action.notDmed: The author could not be DMed.
action.decidedDm: Suggestion #{id}: {status}. The author was told by DM.
action.starboardOff: Starboard is off. Existing starboard posts stay.
action.stickyNotPosted: It could not be posted right now (check my permissions there); it will be posted after the next message.
action.noSticky: That channel has no sticky message.
action.emptyTag: The tag text cannot be empty.
